scope: Only character.StatMod and character.AttackMod Amount closures returning []float64 under internal/characters in the two named built source trees.

method.unit: one syntactic Amount callback, regardless of number of rule IDs, shared calls, or runtime invocations
method.owner: enclosing character.StatMod or character.AttackMod composite literal

remainingCategories.unbridged-callback-slot-write: No shared marker; callback body directly assigns an attributes.<Stat> indexed slot.
remainingCategories.unbridged-local-vector-return: No shared marker or direct slot assignment; callback returns a local []float64 identifier.
remainingCategories.unbridged-field-vector-return: No shared marker or direct slot assignment; callback returns a field such as c.buff. Producer and update timing require review.
remainingCategories.unbridged-indexed-vector-return: No shared marker or direct slot assignment; callback returns an indexed []float64 value.
remainingCategories.unbridged-nil-only: No shared marker and no non-nil return in the callback body.

limitations: This is a syntactic inventory of built Go source, not a count of reachable effects, completed character kits, or gameplay verification.
Return-form classes are lexical evidence only: a local or field return does not prove creation-time snapshot semantics; inspect the producer and lifecycle before migrating.
A callback with a shared marker is counted once even if its formula produces several scalar rule receipts or the callback has multiple branches.
Other modifier families, direct attack fields, reaction/healing/cooldown scalars, and team configuration are outside this denominator.
literalModifierKey is null when the enclosing constructor does not contain a directly quoted modifier.NewBase key; no constant or runtime key is inferred.

sourceIdentityCorrection: Classic commit typo corrected against packages/source-host/dist/manifest.json; builtSourceRoot and callback hashes unchanged.
